formal_definition: The PRA's working description, set out in Annex 1 of its 18 May 2026 Dear CEO letter on deposits, e-money and stablecoins, is a deposit claim held on a programmable ledger that supports techniques such as instant (atomic) settlement and smart-contract automation; the letter cautions that neither standard-setters nor market participants have yet agreed a common meaning for the term. The PRA treats tokenised deposits -- including those structured as transferable liabilities of the issuing deposit-taker, sometimes called 'deposit tokens' -- as ordinary deposits for FSCS depositor-protection purposes, provided the PRA's associated rules and operational requirements for depositor protection are met.
plain_definition: A bank deposit represented as a transferable token on a programmable ledger rather than only as an entry in a bank's internal ledger -- enabling techniques such as near-instant settlement and smart contracts -- while remaining, legally, an ordinary deposit rather than a stablecoin or e-money product.
